description: This file contains unit tests for the BearerTokenValidator class in the OAuth server plugin of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It tests various scenarios for validating OAuth 2.2 Bearer tokens, including missing headers, invalid tokens, expired tokens, revoked tokens, and successful validation, using mock services and requests.

classes.name: BearerTokenValidatorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the OAuth BearerTokenValidator's validation logic under various scenarios, including error handling and successful token validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads fixture data, and sets up the access token repository and encryption key.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithoutAuthorizeHeader
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the Authorization header is missing.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidHeaderValue
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the Authorization header has an invalid value.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidToken
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the token in the Authorization header is invalid.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidEncryptionKey
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the token decryption fails due to an incorrect encryption key.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithRevokedToken
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the access token has been revoked.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithNonExistingToken
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the token decodes correctly but does not exist in the database.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredToken
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the token has expired.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredTokenAfterOneYear
methods.description: Tests validation failure for an expired token with a current time more than a year after expiry.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredAndCurrentTimeSame
methods.description: Validates that the token is still valid if the current time equals the expiry time.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorization
methods.description: Tests successful validation of a valid, unexpired token.
